help_summary: Keep your program shortcuts together with names, descriptions and manuals so you remember what each one is.
help_howto:
• In Explorer, right-click > New > 'Shortcut list' to create a list, then double-click it to open. 'Shortcut list shortcut' keeps the list file in the program folder and creates a shortcut (whose icon you can change) in its place.
• Click + or drop shortcuts and programs onto the window to add them. Dropping several at once adds them all by name without a dialog. In the add window, the [File] [Folder] [App] [Bookmarks] buttons let you pick a file, a folder, an installed app (including Microsoft Store apps), or entries from a bookmarks HTML file exported by your browser.
• Rows with a manual, web address or memo show an icon on the right. If the target is a web address, the site's icon is downloaded and shown (you can turn this off in Settings).
• Choose custom order in the sort menu to drag the handle on the left and reorder.
• Set another list (.sbook) as a target to nest lists like folders.

set_web_icon_check: Download new site icons from the internet when the target is a web address
web_icon_hint: The site is checked once, only when you enter an address, open the edit window, or import bookmarks; it does not keep retrying when offline. Turning this off only stops new downloads: icons already downloaded keep being used. Downloaded icons are saved inside the list file (.sbook) together with each item, so deleting an item or the file removes its icons, and moving the file takes them along. The manual / web address buttons always use the default web icon.

help_keys:
# Items
Enter · Double-click | Run the selected items (all of them if several are selected)
{0} · Alt+Enter | Open the edit window for the selected item. You can change the {0} key in Settings > Edit shortcut
Del | Delete the selected items (asks first)
Ctrl+N | Add a new item
Shift+F10 · Menu key | Open the right-click menu for the selected item
Ctrl+Enter in the edit window | Save and close
# Selecting and moving
Home · End | Select the first / last item
Shift · Ctrl + click | Select several rows (run, delete, move to top or drag them together). Ctrl+A selects all
# Search and windows
Ctrl+F · Ctrl+E | Go to the search box
Esc | Clear the search and return to the list
Backspace · ← · Alt+← · Mouse button 4 | Back to the previous list (when another list was opened in this window)
→ · Alt+→ · Mouse button 5 | Forward again
Ctrl+W | Close this window
F1 | Open this help window
# List file
F5 | Reload the list file (when you edited the file outside the program). Selection and search text are kept
When saving | If the file was changed outside the program, you are asked whether to overwrite it or reload it (so outside changes are not silently lost)
# Mouse
Right-click | Run · Open location · Move to top · Edit · Delete menu
Drag the handle | Reorder (custom order). Drop on the middle of another list's row to move to the end of that list, or between rows in another window (custom order) to move to that spot
Wheel while dragging | Scroll the list
ext_changed_msg:
This list file was changed outside the program (by another program, cloud sync, etc.).

[Yes] Overwrite with your current changes. The outside changes will be lost.
[No] Reload the file's contents. The change you just made will be cancelled.
